description: Given a latitude/longitude, find which administrative boundaries, zones, and regions contain that point. Returns state, district, subdistrict, block, parliament/assembly constituency, pincode, seismic zone, high court jurisdiction, the municipal ward (for the ~30 cities with ward data), and more. The 'where am I?' tool. Also accepts specific layer IDs to check.

layers.description: Specific layer IDs to check. Omit to use the default: 12 essential admin/zone layers PLUS the city ward layer(s) covering the point (for the ~30 cities with ward data). Passing this replaces the default entirely (no ward auto-include).

name: locate
